_comment: Structured by day of week, then by time slot (6am/12pm/6pm PH time) to match the 3x-daily cron schedule. The script auto-selects based on the current Philippine day + time. Set IMAGE_PROMPT / FB_CAPTION env vars to override any single run.

monday.prompt: Bold graphic banner, patriotic Philippine flag color palette (red, blue, gold, white sunburst), large bold sans-serif headline text 'MONDAY MOTIVATION: DISIPLINA PARA SA BAYAN', a stylized golden medal icon and a rising sun graphic in the background, clean modern poster design, high contrast, social-media-ready 1:1 square banner, subtle DDS red accent stripe along the bottom edge
monday.caption: Magandang umaga, mga SOLID! 🇵🇭 Simulan natin ang linggo nang may disiplina at pag-asa. Alalahanin natin — malinis na gobyerno at tunay na paglilingkod, yan ang dapat asahan natin sa bawat pinuno. Tara, gising na! ☀️ #SolidDuterte #DisiplinaParaSaBayan

monday.prompt: Bold graphic banner, warm midday color palette (deep blue sky gradient into gold), large bold headline text 'PROGRESO, HINDI PANGAKO LANG', icon of a construction hard hat crossed with a road/bridge silhouette representing infrastructure development, Philippine flag ribbon accent in corner, clean modern poster layout, high contrast, square 1:1 format
monday.caption: Tanghali na, mga SOLID! 🛠️ Tandaan natin — ang tunay na pagbabago ay nakikita sa mga proyektong natapos, hindi lang sa mga pangako. Build, build, build para sa Pilipinas! 🇵🇭 #ProgresoTayo #SolidDuterte

monday.prompt: Bold graphic banner, sunset orange-to-deep-red gradient background evoking dusk, large bold headline text 'GABI NA, PERO SOLID PA RIN', silhouette of the Philippine archipelago map filled with a subtle national flag pattern, minimalist star and sun emblem in the corner, clean modern poster design, high contrast typography, square 1:1 format
